accepted_scope: Finite unpolarized vacuum Compton plus ordered double-Compton correction and energy-momentum source at sampled resting-electron configurations; independent total cross-section validation
numerical_gate_scope: Three independent vacuum totals; nine differential samples with three quadrature refinements; regulator and separator sequences; three four-force samples with two refinements; source formula and low-energy checks
retained_failure_explanation: One 2% direct logarithmic-asymptotic ratio test converges too slowly because of the nonlogarithmic O(E^2) term; separate difference-quotient and independent-total tests validate the leading coefficient
conclusion: Finite vacuum normalization and source balance now calibrated; next evaluate finite thermal insertions without the unjustified high-energy bath expansion before using the matched source in the parent evolution
